desc:
Welcome to Croydon, the realistic London bus simulator.

🚌 Drive passengers around the city with realistic physics & hundreds of buses to choose from.
🧑‍🧑‍🧒 Connect with likeminded people by driving on Shifts & in Simulation Servers.
🏙️ Become immersed in our massive, recently upgraded map.
📈 Create & grow your own bus company and compete against others on weekly leaderboards.
🧐 Simulate real life features such as interactive ticket machines, advanced sounds, and more.
🚃 Take a drive on our extensive tram network!
🔊 Chat to other drivers with voice!

Recommended RAM: 8GB+

Change Log: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/croydon-changelog/3270881/
Experience Rules: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/croydon-experience-rules/3305473

badges.name: My First Route
badges.desc: Well done! You've completed your first route successfully! Keep exploring — there's a lot more to this game!

badges.name: 10 Routes
badges.desc: You've completed ten routes. You're settling in!

badges.name: 100 Routes
badges.desc: You've completed 100 routes. Impressive! But your driving journey doesn't stop here...

badges.name: 1000 routes
badges.desc: One thousand routes! 6 bright days of driving altogether...you're one of our best drivers...

badges.name: First Passenger
badges.desc: Your bus driving career starts here! Successfully give a passenger the correct ticket

badges.name: 10 Passengers
badges.desc: You've not given your passengers whiplash yet, and 10 have successfully boarded your bus!

badges.name: 50th Passenger
badges.desc: 50 Passengers have boarded your bus. You must be doing something right

badges.name: 500th Passenger
badges.desc: 500 People have boarded your bus and only some received minor injuries. Good job.

badges.name: 5000th Passenger
badges.desc: 5000 passengers have had the misfortune of riding your bus, but at the end of the day, bus is bus

badges.name: Empire Builder
badges.desc: Begin your transport empire by creating your own company!

badges.name: Route Builder
badges.desc: Dominate the town by creating your own bus route!

badges.name: Location Hunter
badges.desc: You've travelled around town and have started to find some places

badges.name: Location Master
badges.desc: You have managed to explore every area in the game. But don't forget to re-visit; you'll always see something you haven't seen before, like a Coincrete.

badges.name: Spawn A Tram
badges.desc: Trams are by far the best method of urban mass transport, and you have now become part of it
